plan.title: School Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Enrolment trends, infrastructure gaps, and gender comparison

panels.title: Enrolment Trend for Girls
panels.sql: SELECT '2022' AS year, SUM("Girls 2022") AS total FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT '2023', SUM("Girls 2023") FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT '2024', SUM("Girls 2024") FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Enrolment Trend for Boys
panels.sql: SELECT '2022' AS year, SUM("Boys 2022") AS total FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT '2023', SUM("Boys 2023") FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT '2024', SUM("Boys 2024") FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Infrastructure Gaps by Block
panels.sql: SELECT "Block", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Toilets functional (girls)" = 'No') AS no_toilets, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Drinking water" = 'No') AS no_water, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "Electricity" = 'No') AS no_electricity FROM "school_infrastructure" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Schools by Total Enrolment
panels.sql: SELECT "School Name", ("Girls 2022" + "Girls 2023" + "Girls 2024" + "Boys 2022" + "Boys 2023" + "Boys 2024") AS total_enrolment FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" ORDER BY total_enrolment DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The enrolment trends for girls and boys over the years 2022 to 2024 are visualized in panels p1 and p2, respectively. Panel p3 highlights the infrastructure gaps by block, showing the number of schools lacking functional toilets, drinking water, and electricity. Panel p4 lists the top 10 schools by total enrolment, combining data from both genders across the years.
